result_text:
I fixed the four default scoping conventions in `ScopingConventions.java`. The module compiles and its tests run offline with no failure output. I did not add a test for the new matches.

Changes, all in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`:

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern was `(html|html|xhtml)`, so `.htm` never matched. It is now `(htm|html|xhtml)`, which also removes the duplicated `html`.
- **.NET assembly docs `<doc>` XML rule:** `.*/[.]xml` required a slash before a literal dot. It is now `.*[.]xml`.
- **JavaScript `// Generated by …` rule:** `.*/[.]js` had the same problem. It is now `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript rule:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` required a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`.

Path patterns in `SourceFileFilter` are full-match, so the new patterns should match `page.htm`, `MyAssembly.xml`, `app.js` and `build-gradle.js`. Existing matches such as `.html`, `.xhtml`, `build.gradle` and `.gradle` are unchanged. Hand-written `.js`, `.xml` and `.htm` files are still excluded unless their content matches, since the content rules are unchanged.

I tried a small ad-hoc regex check but the sandbox denied it, so the pattern behaviour above is from reading the code, not a run. Nothing was committed.
